# Renaissance Labs Code

> A verified taxonomy of datasets, RL environments, benchmarks and tools for training coding models, with a recipe builder and an honest guide. Every entry was checked against its primary source on the date shown. Machine-readable data: https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/data/resources.json

## Pages
- [Catalog](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/catalog/): all 319 resources, filterable
- [Recipe builder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/recipe/): ordered plan from model size, budget, languages and goal
- [Guide: how to improve any model at coding](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/guide/)
- [Pitfalls](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/pitfalls/)
- [About and method](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/about/)

## Stages
- [Data: pretrain and mid-train](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/pretrain/): Raw code, cleaned and mixed. Where a model learns what code looks like. (52 resources)
- [SFT: instructions, reasoning, trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/sft/): Teach the format: follow instructions, explain, edit, call tools, solve step by step. (113 resources)
- [Preference and reward data](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/preference/): Teach what better means: pairs and judgments that rank code, ideally grounded in tests. (17 resources)
- [RL with verifiable rewards](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/rl/): Let the model try, run the tests, reward what passes. Environments, task sets, and verifiers. (117 resources)
- [Evaluation](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/eval/): Benchmarks and harnesses. How you know whether anything worked. (100 resources)
- [Tools: data pipelines, sandboxes, trainers](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/stage/tooling/): Dedup, decontamination, sandboxes, and the frameworks that run the training. (61 resources)

## Data
- [resources.json](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/data/resources.json)
- [resources.csv](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/data/resources.csv)
