- [snippets.json](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/data/snippets.json)

## Resources

### Data: pretrain and mid-train
- [Code Llama 70B (legacy)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codellama-70b/): Meta's 2024 code Llama; included for historical comparison only. [model; license: Llama 2 community license (custom Meta license)]
- [Codestral-22B-v0.1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codestral-22b/): Mistral's 2024 code model; weights open for research and testing only. [model; license: Mistral Non-Production License (MNPL-0.1)]
- [CommitPack](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/commitpack/): Raw commit corpus (code before/after plus message) from which CommitPackFT was filtered. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card tag); per-file source licenses are permissive]
- [Common Pile: Stack v2 (openly licensed)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/common-pile-stackv2/): Stack v2 filtered to openly licensed repos (all detected licenses on the Blue Oak list), part of the Common Pile v0.1 for license-clean pretraining. [dataset; license: per-document licenses in metadata.license; only Blue Oak Council certified licenses kept (HF license field unset)]
- [Common Pile: Stack v2 edu filtered](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/common-pile-stackv2-edu/): Educational-quality subset of the openly licensed Stack v2 used for Comma v0.1. [dataset; license: per-document licenses; Blue Oak certified only (HF license field unset)]
- [Cosmopedia](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/cosmopedia/): Large synthetic textbooks, blog posts and stories generated from seed web data; includes code-flavored subsets used in SmolLM pretraining. [dataset; license: apache-2.0 (cardData.license)]
- [DeepSeek-Coder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-deepseek-coder/): Repo-level pretraining data construction (dependency-ordered files) and fill-in-the-middle for code models. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [DeepSeek-Coder-V2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-deepseek-coder-v2/): Continued pretraining of a MoE on code and math tokens to reach closed-model-level code results at release. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [DeepSeek-Coder-V2 (Instruct 236B / Lite)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepseek-coder-v2/): June 2024 MoE code model continued-pretrained from DeepSeek-V2; strong at release, now legacy. [model; license: DeepSeek model license (HF 'other: deepseek-license'; code under MIT)]
- [Dolma 3 Dolmino mix (100B)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/dolma3-dolmino-mix-100b/): Ai2 OLMo 3 mid-training mix with fill-in-the-middle Stack-Edu, synthetic Python (CraneCode) and code meta-reasoning data. [dataset; license: odc-by (cardData.license)]
- [FineMath](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/finemath/): High-quality math web pages with step-by-step reasoning, used with code in SmolLM2 mid-training. [dataset; license: odc-by]
- [GitHub Code (CodeParrot)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/github-code/): BigQuery-derived GitHub dump with repo, path, language and license per file; used for CodeParrot. [dataset; license: license:other; per-file license field per repo (mix of permissive and copyleft)]
- [GitHub Code Clean](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/github-code-clean/): Filtered github-code: average line length under 100, alphanumeric fraction over 0.25 and autogenerated files removed. [dataset; license: apache-2.0 (dataset label); per-file repo licenses still apply]
- [GitHub Jupyter parsed](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/github-jupyter-parsed/): Jupyter notebooks parsed to markdown (as text) and Python code cells only. [dataset; license: license:other; each example has its repo's license (15 licenses per card)]
- [Granite Code 8B Base](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/granite-8b-code-base/): IBM enterprise-oriented code model trained on license-permissive data; legacy but cleanly licensed. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [H4 Stack Exchange preferences](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/stack-exchange-preferences/): Stack Overflow questions with at least two scored answers, built for preference-model training and usable for LM training. [dataset; license: cc-by-sa-4.0]
- [Jupyter code-text pairs](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/jupyter-code-text-pairs/): Pairs of notebook markdown and code from Jupyter notebooks (BigCode). [dataset; license: not stated (HF license field unset; card is empty)]
- [Nemotron-CC-Code-v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-cc-code-v1/): NVIDIA's code-from-web pretraining set: code-related pages from Common Crawl, reprocessed for training; part of the Nemotron pretraining family. [dataset; license: gated (manual): NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training; tags cc-by-4.0, cc-by-sa-4.0, gfdl, other]
- [Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-pretraining-code-v1/): Code part of NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 2 pretraining data: LLM-synthesized code and metadata for a permissively licensed GitHub subset. [dataset; license: gated (manual): NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training; license:other]
- [Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-pretraining-code-v2/): Second Nemotron code pretraining release: more GitHub metadata plus synthetic code data. [dataset; license: gated (manual): NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training; license:other]
- [Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v3 (metadata)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-pretraining-code-v3/): Incremental metadata list of permissively licensed GitHub files for Nemotron 3 Ultra pretraining; use with v1/v2. [dataset; license: cc-by-4.0 for the metadata; code files under their own licenses]
- [Olmo 3 32B (Base/Think)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/olmo-3-32b/): Fully open (weights, data, checkpoints incl. stage1/2/3) Allen AI model suite with Base, Instruct and Think; best for transparent post-training research. No dedicated 'OLMo-Coder' was found. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [OpenCoder annealing corpus](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opc-annealing-corpus/): Annealing-phase data of OpenCoder: algorithm-related code from The Stack v2 plus synthetic rewrites and synthetic QA seeded from it. [dataset; license: odc-by]
- [OpenCoder FineWeb code corpus](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opc-fineweb-code-corpus/): Code-related web pages recalled from FineWeb with a trained fastText-style recall pipeline (url, tag, text, file_path, dump fields). [dataset; license: mit (cardData.license); underlying web pages carry their own rights]
- [OpenCoder FineWeb math corpus](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opc-fineweb-math-corpus/): Math-related web pages recalled from FineWeb, used alongside code in OpenCoder pretraining. [dataset; license: odc-by (cardData.license)]
- [OpenCoder repo](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencoder-repo/): Code, data-processing pipeline and training recipe behind OpenCoder. [recipe; license: MIT]
- [OpenCoder-8B (Base/Instruct)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencoder-8b/): Fully transparent code LLM: weights plus data pipeline, ablations and training protocol released. Best choice for studying code pretraining and annealing recipes end to end. [model; license: 'inf' license (HF other); card says commercial use supported]
- [OpenCoder: The Open Cookbook](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-opencoder/): Releases weights plus reproducible data pipeline, ablations and training protocol for a top-tier code LLM at its release. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [OpenWebMath](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/open-web-math/): Math web documents extracted from Common Crawl with LaTeX preserved; used in StarCoder2 and many mixes. [dataset; license: odc-by (card); underlying pages unspecified]
- [Qwen2.5-Coder family (32B shown)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen2-5-coder/): Sep-Nov 2024 code-specialized Qwen family with base and instruct variants from 0.5B to 32B. Still the most widely used open base for code SFT/RL recipes (SWE-smith, OpenHands LM, Open-R1 style work). [model; license: Apache-2.0 (verified for 32B and 7B; check each size's card)]
- [Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-qwen2-5-coder/): Describes data, training and evaluation for the Qwen2.5-Coder family. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Qwen3-Coder-Next (and -Base)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen3-coder-next/): Open-weight coding-agent model from Jan 2026 built for local agents (80B total, 3B active). A Base variant is published for further post-training. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [RefineCode (metadata)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/refinecode-meta/): Repo and path metadata to reproduce OpenCoder's RefineCode pretraining corpus, which applies 130+ language-specific heuristic rules. [dataset; license: mit (metadata); underlying code per-repo licenses]
- [Rho-1: Not All Tokens Are What You Need](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-rho-1/): Selective language modeling: train on tokens with high excess loss versus a reference model. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Seed-Coder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-seed-coder/): Model-centric pipeline: LLMs score and filter code pretraining data instead of hand rules. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Seed-Coder-8B (Base/Instruct/Reasoning)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/seed-coder-8b/): ByteDance Seed (2025) family built from model-curated pretraining data; base, instruct and RL-trained reasoning variants in one permissive license. [model; license: MIT]
- [SmolLM recipes](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/smollm-recipes/): Training, data and eval recipes for the SmolLM family including Stack-Edu related data. [recipe; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SmolLM-Corpus (Python-Edu, Cosmopedia, FineWeb-Edu-Dedup)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/smollm-corpus/): Pretraining corpus of SmolLM v1 including Python-Edu: Python files scored 4 or more by an educational code classifier. [dataset; license: odc-by (cardData.license)]
- [SmolLM2 (Stack-Edu)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-smollm2/): Data-centric small-model training; introduces Stack-Edu (education-quality code filter), FineMath, SmolTalk and manual mix refinement. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [SmolLM3-3B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/smollm3-3b/): Fully open 3B model with dual-mode reasoning; handy as a tiny testbed for code recipes (see smollm repo). [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Stack-Edu](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/stack-edu/): Educational-quality subset of StarCoder2Data, selected with language-specific classifiers (score and int_score columns), built for SmolLM2. Ships blob ids, not file text. [dataset; license: not stated in dataset card (HF license field unset); underlying files are permissively licensed StarCoder2Data (see license_type and detected_licenses columns)]
- [StarCoder 2 and The Stack v2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-starcoder2/): Documents the open data, opt-out and training for StarCoder2 on The Stack v2. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [StarCoder2 data extras](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/starcoder2data-extras/): The non-code parts of the StarCoder2 mix: arXiv, GitHub issues, Stack Overflow, Wikipedia, Kaggle notebooks, docs, LLVM IR and OpenWebMath. [dataset; license: not stated in card (HF license field unset); components carry their own licenses (e.g. Stack Overflow CC-BY-SA, Wikipedia, arXiv)]
- [StarCoder2-15B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/starcoder2-15b/): Open pretrained code model trained on The Stack v2 with opt-outs excluded; the data and training are documented. [model; license: BigCode OpenRAIL-M (use restrictions apply)]
- [StarCoderData](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/starcoderdata/): The StarCoder (v1) training set: filtered code from The Stack plus GitHub issues, commits and Jupyter, in ready-to-train form. [dataset; license: gated (auto): BigCode terms; license:other]
- [Textbooks Are All You Need (phi-1)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-textbooks/): 1.3B model trained on 6B tokens of filtered web 'textbook quality' code plus 1B tokens of synthetic textbooks reaches 50.6% HumanEval (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [The Stack GitHub issues](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/stack-github-issues/): GitHub issue and discussion text collected for StarCoder-era training. [dataset; license: gated (auto); license field unset]
- [The Stack v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/the-stack-v1/): First BigCode corpus of permissively licensed GitHub code (2022 cutoff), used for StarCoder and SantaCoder. [dataset; license: gated (auto): BigCode terms; license:other; permissive source licenses, per-file license field]
- [The Stack v2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/the-stack-v2/): StarCoder2 training corpus built on the Software Heritage archive (2023), with per-file license labels. The HF release holds metadata and SWH blob ids; contents come from the SWH S3 bucket. [dataset; license: gated (auto): BigCode terms; license:other; per-file licenses vary (see card)]
- [The Stack v2 (dedup)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/the-stack-v2-dedup/): Near-deduplicated variant of The Stack v2 (metadata plus SWH blob ids) for building custom training mixes. [dataset; license: gated (auto): BigCode terms; license:other; per-file licenses vary]
- [The Stack v2 train (smol ids)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/the-stack-v2-train-smol-ids/): Id list for the smaller training subset of The Stack v2 used in StarCoder2 training; a lightweight route to a few-hundred-billion-token mix. [dataset; license: gated (auto): BigCode terms; license:other]
- [The Stack v3 (train)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/the-stack-v3-train/): Successor to The Stack v2: a direct GitHub crawl (cutoff 2025-08-07) with file contents inline, grouped by repository, near-deduplicated, quality filtered and PII redacted. Built for repo-level code pretraining. [dataset; license: odc-by (dataset card); per-file source licenses recorded in license_type (permissive or no_license) and detected_licenses]

### SFT: instructions, reasoning, trajectories
- [Alignment Handbook](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/alignment-handbook/): Hugging Face recipes for SFT and preference alignment. [recipe; license: Apache-2.0]
- [APPS](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/apps/): Interview-level and competition Python problems with solutions and test cases. [dataset; license: MIT (card list)]
- [Axolotl](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/axolotl/): YAML-driven fine-tuning framework with multi-GPU and many model families. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Bespoke-Stratos-17k](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/bespoke-stratos-17k/): DeepSeek-R1 distillation of the Sky-T1 recipe (code, math, science, puzzles) used for Bespoke-Stratos models; made at about $800 of generation per the card. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Code Alpaca 20K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/code-alpaca-20k/): Self-Instruct-style code instruction set that started the open code-instruction line; seed of Evol-CodeAlpaca. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0 (HF card)]
- [Code-Feedback (OpenCodeInterpreter)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/code-feedback/): Multi-turn code data with execution feedback and human-feedback-style follow-ups for iterative refinement (OpenCodeInterpreter). [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [CodeContests (DeepMind)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/code-contests/): Competitive problems from Codeforces, CodeChef, AtCoder and others with generated tests and correct/incorrect human solutions in Python, C++ and Java. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codefeedback-filtered-instruction/): 287K queries from Magicoder-OSS, Python ShareGPT, Magicoder-Evol and Evol-Instruct, filtered to complexity 4-5 by Qwen-72B-Chat. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [CommitPackFT](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/commitpackft/): Filtered subset of CommitPack where commit messages resemble natural-language instructions; basis of OctoPack/OctoCoder instruction tuning. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card tag); per-file source licenses are permissive]
- [DeepSeek-V3.2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepseek-v3-2/): Dec 2025 DeepSeek V3 line model, MIT licensed; a common open teacher and RL starting point before V4. [model; license: MIT]
- [DeepSeek-V4-Pro (and V4-Flash-0731)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepseek-v4-pro/): DeepSeek V4 generation (Apr 2026): Pro is the largest open DeepSeek; V4-Flash-0731 card says it outperforms V4-Pro (Preview) on listed benchmarks despite far fewer active parameters. [model; license: MIT]
- [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepseek-v4-1-flash/): Sep 2026 DeepSeek open MoE with 1M context, MIT licensed; the card describes an encoder-decoder (CED) design with KV-cache compression. [model; license: MIT]
- [Devstral 2 (123B)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/devstral-2-123b/): Larger Dec 2025 Devstral for agentic coding under a modified MIT license. [model; license: Modified MIT License (see LICENSE file; third-party-rights restriction in card)]
- [Devstral Small 2 (24B)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/devstral-small-2/): Dec 2025 Mistral agentic coding model, Apache licensed; earlier Devstral-Small-2505 and 2507 are also Apache-2.0 (verified). [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [EditPackFT](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/editpackft/): Further-filtered CommitPackFT subset formatted for instructional code editing (before code, instruction, after code), used to train CanItEdit-evaluated models. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card)]
- [Evol-CodeAlpaca v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evol-codealpaca-v1/): Open re-creation of the WizardCoder Evol-Instruct code data: Code Alpaca 20K evolved with 10 augmentation strategies and answered by GPT-4. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [Evol-Instruct-Code-80k-v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evol-instruct-code-80k/): Community replication of the WizardCoder Evol-Instruct code data. [dataset; license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (HF card)]
- [Glaive Code Assistant v3](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/glaive-code-assistant-v3/): Synthetic code Q&A from Glaive's data platform; v3 includes v1 and v2. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [GLM-5.3](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/glm-5-3/): Aug 2026 Z.ai open model; card says it uses the GLM-5.2 base with gains from post-training only, and claims open-source SOTA on Terminal Bench 3.0. [model; license: Custom 'glm-5.3' license: MIT-like with Model-as-a-Service revenue condition (security review above USD 10B revenue)]
- [GLM-5.3-Flash](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/glm-5-3-flash/): Aug 2026 smaller GLM-5.3 with new base model, hybrid sparse/linear attention and native multimodality; MIT licensed. [model; license: MIT]
- [gpt-oss-120b](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/gpt-oss-120b/): Aug 2025 OpenAI open-weight reasoning model with an Apache license; a permissive teacher/baseline. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [gretelai/synthetic_text_to_sql](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/gretel-synthetic-text-to-sql/): Synthetic text-to-SQL with schemas, prompts, SQL and explanations across many SQL task types. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kimi-k3-1-pro/): Nov 2026 open-weight agentic model post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint RL; the largest open model checked here. [model; license: Custom 'Kimi K3.1 Pro' license: permissive with conditions (MaaS operators above USD 20M revenue need a separate agreement; attribution above 100M MAU or USD 20M monthly revenue)]
- [Kimi-Dev-72B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kimi-dev-72b/): Qwen2.5-72B-based SWE model trained with Agentless-style RL; card reports 60.4% on SWE-bench Verified (Moonshot-reported, workflow approach). [model; license: MIT]
- [Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-kimi-dev/): Argues Agentless-style training induces localization/edit/reflection priors; the abstract reports 60.4% on SWE-bench Verified (workflow mode) and 48.6% pass@1 as an agent after SFT on 5k public trajectories. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [KodCode-V1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kodcode/): Fully synthetic coding questions with solutions and pytest-style tests validated by execution; fields include gpt pass percentage and difficulty. [dataset; license: CC-BY-NC-4.0]
- [KodCode-V1-SFT-R1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kodcode-v1-sft-r1/): KodCode with DeepSeek-R1 responses kept via test-based rejection sampling; columns include r1_solution, r1_correctness and gpt_difficulty. [dataset; license: CC-BY-NC-4.0]
- [Lean Workbook](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/lean-workbook/): Auto-formalized competition-style problems in Lean 4, used for theorem-prover RL; Goedel-LM/Lean-workbook-proofs has 29,750 proofs. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Lego-RL-2699 and LegoFlow-SWE](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/lego-rl-2699/): SWE-Lego family: Harbor-format RL environments, teacher trajectories and a Harbor-packaged SWE-bench Verified for evaluating against the same trainer. [environment; license: AGPL-3.0 (RL set); Apache-2.0 (LegoFlow-SWE, SWE-Lego-Real-Data)]
- [LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-lima/): About 1,000 curated examples can align a model, arguing for quality over quantity in SFT. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Ling-Coder-SFT](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/ling-coder-sft/): Subset of the SFT data used for Ling-Coder-Lite, synthesized with OSS-Instruct and Evol-Instruct style pipelines. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [LLaMA-Factory](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/llama-factory/): Unified fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs and VLMs (SFT, DPO, etc.) with a web UI. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Llama-Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset (code)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/llama-nemotron-post-training/): Post-training data for Llama-3.3-Nemotron-70B and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B; v1.1 added 500K code reasoning samples. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0 (card also notes Llama-derived-data redistribution requirements)]
- [Magicoder Evol-Instruct 110K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/magicoder-evol-instruct-110k/): Decontaminated version of theblackcat102/evol-codealpaca-v1 (WizardCoder-style Evol-Instruct on Code Alpaca seeds), decontaminated with the StarCoder/BigCode procedure. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [Magicoder OSS-Instruct 75K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/magicoder-oss-instruct-75k/): Synthetic instructions generated by prompting an LLM with random open-source code snippets (OSS-Instruct) to reduce the bias of purely LLM-invented tasks. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card)]
- [Magicoder: OSS-Instruct](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-magicoder/): Seeds an LLM with real open-source snippets to generate 75K diverse, realistic instruction pairs; 7B models beat larger ones at release. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Magpie-Qwen2.5-Coder-Pro-300K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/magpie-qwen25-coder-pro-300k/): Raw conversations built by the Magpie self-synthesis method with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct; includes task_category, difficulty and quality columns. [dataset; license: other (HF card tag; check card)]
- [nebius SWE-agent-trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nebius-swe-agent-trajectories/): SWE-agent trajectories with resolved or failed labels and patches, from a Llama-3.1-70B based agent on SWE-bench-like tasks. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [nebius SWE-rebench OpenHands trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nebius-swe-rebench-openhands-trajectories/): OpenHands trajectories on SWE-rebench tasks generated with Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-Agentic-Tool-Use-v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-agentic-v1/): Multi-turn tool-use conversations: interactive-agent trajectories (simulated user, agent, tool environment) and general tool-calling, judge-filtered. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-Cascade-RL-SWE](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-cascade-rl-swe/): NVIDIA recipe data for SWE RL: difficulty-filtered mix of SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-rebench, SWE-smith, R2E-Gym-Subset and SWE-Fixer, with repos from SWE-bench Verified excluded to avoid contamination. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-Cascade-SFT-SWE](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-cascade-sft-swe/): Agentless-mini style SWE SFT data (localization, repair, test generation) from SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-reBench and SWE-Smith, difficulty-selected and decontaminated against SWE-Bench Verified repos. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1 (code split)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-post-training-v1/): SFT compilation behind Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1.5 with reasoning on/off responses; the code split carries reasoning traces. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-SFT-Competitive-Programming-v2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-competitive-programming-v2/): Competitive coding with reasoning and critique, Python Exercism-style exercises (Aider problems decontaminated), and enterprise text-to-SQL records generated with NVIDIA Data Designer. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0, ODC-By, MIT (API list)]
- [Nemotron-SFT-OpenCode-v1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-sft-opencode-v1/): Agentic instruction data for the OpenCode CLI: tool calling, AGENTS.md prompts, agent skills, bash-only tools and clarifying-question tool, in six subsets. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [Nemotron-SFT-SWE-v2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-sft-swe-v2/): SWE-Bench-style data: OpenHands agentic trajectories and agentless sub-task SFT data built from SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-reBench, SWE-Smith and SWE-Fixer-Train. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0 plus Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD (API list)]
- [NuminaMath-LEAN](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/numinamath-lean/): Competition problems with formal statements, ground-truth proofs and an rl_data field for Lean 4 training. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-3-ultra/): Jun 2026 hybrid Mamba-2 plus MoE general model whose card includes SWE-bench Verified and LiveCodeBench rows; a permissively licensed (OpenMDW) very large teacher. [model; license: OpenMDW-1.1]
- [NVIDIA SWE-Zero / SWE-Hero OpenHands trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-swe-trajectories/): OpenHands agent trajectories with model_patch and repo license columns, for SFT or rejection sampling on SWE tasks. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [OctoPack: Instruction Tuning Code LLMs](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-octopack/): CommitPack: 4 TB of Git commits across 350 languages used as natural code-instruction data; 46.2% HumanEval pass@1 for StarCoder-16B tuned without OpenAI outputs (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Open-R1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/open-r1/): Hugging Face's open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1: SFT, GRPO training scripts, code-reward environments and datasets. [recipe; license: Apache-2.0]
- [open-r1 CodeForces-CoTs](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codeforces-cots/): DeepSeek-R1 chain-of-thought solutions in C++ and Python for Codeforces problems, used to train OlympicCoder. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [open-r1 Mixture-of-Thoughts (code)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/mixture-of-thoughts/): Verified DeepSeek-R1 reasoning traces across math, code and science; code part is competitive-programming focused. [dataset; license: not stated in API tags (check card)]
- [open-r1/codeforces](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/open-r1-codeforces/): Codeforces problems with statements, editorials, official tests and generated checkers, including interactive problems; the 'verifiable' config keeps problems with complete tests. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [OpenCodeInstruct (NVIDIA)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencodeinstruct/): Largest open code instruction set: each row has question, solution, generated unit tests, execution results and an LLM quality assessment, so you can filter by test score. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [OpenCoder opc-sft-stage1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opc-sft-stage1/): Stage-1 SFT mix of OpenCoder: filtered general instructions plus large-scale synthetic and real-user code instructions. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card tag)]
- [OpenCoder opc-sft-stage2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opc-sft-stage2/): High-quality stage-2 code SFT: educational synthetic, evolved, McEval-style multilingual and package-usage instructions. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card tag)]
- [OpenCodeReasoning](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencodereasoning/): R1-generated reasoning solutions for competitive problems with difficulty column and source license column. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [OpenCodeReasoning](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-opencodereasoning/): SFT-only distillation dataset for competitive coding; abstract reports 61.8% LiveCodeBench and 24.6% CodeContests and analyzes execution filtering. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [OpenCodeReasoning-2 (NVIDIA)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencodereasoning-2/): Second release: R1 generations with QwQ critiques and right/wrong judgements, for both code completion and code critique SFT. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [OpenCodeReasoning-Nemotron-32B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencodereasoning-nemotron-32b/): NVIDIA reasoning code model distilled via SFT only from the OpenCodeReasoning dataset on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [OpenHands LM 32B v0.1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openhands-lm-32b/): Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct tuned on SWE-Gym-derived data for the OpenHands agent; card reports 37.2% SWE-bench Verified resolve rate. [model; license: MIT]
- [OpenSWE (GAIR, daVinci-Env)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openswe/): Large open set of executable Python SWE environments with synthesis pipeline released. [environment; license: other (gated, access conditions on card); code repo licensed per GitHub as NOASSERTION; search snippet says AGPL-3.0 (unverified)]
- [OpenThoughts-114k](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openthoughts-114k/): DeepSeek-R1 reasoning traces with correctness verification; code rows include test cases and starter code. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [OpenThoughts-Agent-v1-SFT](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openthoughts-agent-v1-sft/): Teacher-agent traces on nl2bash and InferredBugs (C# and Java bugs) tasks, in the Terminus-2 harness, used for OpenThinker-Agent-v1. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [OpenThoughts3-1.2M](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openthoughts3-1.2m/): Result of 1,000+ controlled data-recipe experiments; each question annotated 16x with QwQ-32B. Trains OpenThinker3-7B. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b/): Small MoE Qwen3 coder that is easy to fine-tune and serve; the most downloaded recent Qwen coder in HF search (about 1.95M downloads on the check date). [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen3-coder-480b-a35b/): July 2025 flagship Qwen coder: large MoE for agentic coding and repository-scale context. Commonly used as a permissively licensed teacher for trajectory distillation. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Qwen3.8-27B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen3-8-27b/): Newest open Qwen generation (Aug 2026): dense vision-language model with thinking mode and gains in coding and long-horizon agentic tasks. A strong post-trained starting point for SFT/RL on a single node, and a mid-size teacher. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [R2E-Gym](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-r2e-gym/): Procedural SWE environment of 8.7K tasks via test generation and back-translation from commits; 34.4% on SWE-bench Verified with a 32B model; hybrid test-time scaling (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [R2E-Gym (Subset)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/r2e-gym/): Procedurally generated executable environments from commits (back-translated issue text, LM-generated tests) used to train SWE agents and verifiers; includes dev splits in the Lite variant. [environment; license: Apache-2.0]
- [rStar-Coder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/rstar-coder/): Competitive problems with mutually verified test cases, with configs synthetic_sft, synthetic_rl, synthetic_rl_testcase, seed_sft, seed_testcase. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [SelfCodeAlign](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-selfcodealign/): Self-alignment pipeline: model extracts concepts, generates tasks, samples responses with tests, keeps passing examples; 74k pairs from CodeQwen1.5-7B (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Sky-T1 data 17K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sky-t1-data-17k/): Training data of Sky-T1-32B-Preview (code and math with QwQ-generated reasoning). [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SmolTalk](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/smoltalk/): General SFT mixture used for SmolLM2 with code-containing subsets such as smol-magpie-ultra. [dataset; license: not stated in API tags (check card)]
- [Spider](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/spider/): Cross-domain text-to-SQL; databases are executable SQLite so execution accuracy gives a reward. [dataset; license: CC-BY-SA-4.0]
- [StarCoder2 self-oss-instruct (SelfCodeAlign data)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/self-oss-instruct-sc2-exec-filter-50k/): Instruction data produced by StarCoder2-15B itself via the SelfCodeAlign pipeline (concept extraction, task generation, sampled responses with tests, execution filter). Used for StarCoder2-15B-Instruct. [dataset; license: ODC-By (HF card tag)]
- [SWE-agent-LM-32B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-agent-lm-32b/): SWE-smith showcase: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct fine-tuned on 5k SWE-agent trajectories generated with Claude 3.7 Sonnet. [model; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SWE-bench-extra](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-extra/): Nebius earlier large SWE-bench-format task collection (patch, test_patch, F2P/P2P, license per instance), precursor to SWE-rebench. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [SWE-Dev](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-dev/): Feature-driven development tasks: product requirement, partial source, developer-written unit tests and ground-truth code, supporting SFT and RL with test-based reward. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SWE-Flow / Repo2RLEnv swe_flow recipe](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-flow/): Test-driven synthesis: trace passing tests, remove exercised functions, ask the agent to reconstruct them, reward via retained tests. Hugging Face Repo2RLEnv now packages the recipe as Harbor tasks. [environment; license: MIT]
- [SWE-Gym](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-gym/): Real GitHub issue tasks with FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests, built for training and verifying SWE agents. Lite (230) and Raw (64,689 unvalidated PR rows) variants exist. [environment; license: MIT]
- [SWE-Gym](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-swe-gym/): First environment for training SWE agents: 2,438 real Python tasks with executable runtimes; up to 19% absolute gains on SWE-bench Verified/Lite via SFT, plus trained verifiers (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [SWE-Gym OpenHands sampled trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-gym-openhands-trajectories/): OpenHands trajectories sampled on SWE-Gym tasks with a resolved flag, with trajectory-level resolved labels. [dataset; license: not stated in API tags (check card)]
- [SWE-rebench (nebius, v1)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-rebench/): Continuously mined Python GitHub issue tasks with install configs, F2P/P2P tests and docker_image names, from Nebius; also feeds a decontaminated leaderboard. [environment; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [SWE-rebench V2](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-rebench-v2/): Language-agnostic executable SWE tasks with pre-built images, F2P/P2P tests and LLM quality filtering. A companion set has 126,300 PR-derived tasks. [environment; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [SWE-smith](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-smith/): Synthetic bug-injection tasks generated per repo (LM-written, rewritten, procedural and PR-mirror bugs) with test-based validation and per-task Docker image names. Java and other-language variants are listed under SWE-bench on HF. [environment; license: MIT]
- [SWE-smith](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-swe-smith/): Pipeline that turns any Python repo into an execution environment and synthesizes 100s-1000s of task instances by breaking tests; builds a 50k-instance dataset from 128 repos (abstract). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [SWE-smith trajectories](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-smith-trajectories/): SWE-agent trajectories with Claude 3.7 Sonnet on SWE-smith instances; columns include messages, resolved, model and patch. [dataset; license: MIT]
- [SWE-Synth](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-synth/): Synthetic bug-fix instances with setup patches, F2P/P2P tests and problem statements, plus Moatless SFT trajectories in sibling datasets. [dataset; license: none stated on dataset card (null in API)]
- [SynSQL-2.5M](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/synsql-2.5m/): Million-scale synthetic cross-domain text-to-SQL used to train the OmniSQL models. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SYNTHETIC-1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/synthetic-1/): Prime Intellect crowdsourced DeepSeek-R1 traces with verification_info and score columns across math, coding, SWE and more. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [TACO](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/taco/): Large algorithmic problem set with tests, solutions, difficulty and algorithm tags, aggregated from many contest sites. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0]
- [torchtune](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/torchtune/): PyTorch-native post-training library. [tool; license: BSD-3-Clause]
- [Tulu 3 SFT Mixture (code parts)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/tulu-3-sft-mixture/): General SFT mixture for Tulu 3; a template for how much code to blend into a general assistant. [dataset; license: ODC-By-1.0 overall; subsets carry other licenses, some non-commercial (card)]
- [Unsloth](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/unsloth/): Memory-efficient fine-tuning and RL library with GGUF export and local UI. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [WizardCoder: Evol-Instruct for code](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-wizardcoder/): Adapts Evol-Instruct to progressively harder code instructions and fine-tunes StarCoder. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]

### Preference and reward data
- [AceCode-87K (TIGER-Lab)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/acecode-87k/): Questions rewritten by GPT-4o-mini with synthesized test cases; includes completions with pass rates, used for reward models and RL (AceCoder). [dataset; license: MIT (HF card)]
- [AceCode-V2-122K (TIGER-Lab)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/acecode-v2-122k/): Improved AceCode: questions and tests rewritten by OpenAI o1-mini and filtered with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct; card includes RL results for Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Base. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [AceCodePair-300K (TIGER-Lab)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/acecodepair-300k/): Test-case-derived preference pairs built from AceCode-87K pass rates, used to train AceCode reward models with Bradley-Terry loss. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card tag)]
- [AceCoder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-acecoder/): Automated test-case synthesis creates (question, tests) pairs for reward models and RL; best-of-32 gains of about 5 to 10 points reported. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [CodeUltraFeedback](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codeultrafeedback/): Preference data: coding instructions with responses ranked on five coding preferences by GPT-3.5 as judge, with scores and textual feedback. [dataset; license: MIT (HF card)]
- [Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling (CodeRM)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-coderm/): More generated unit tests give better reward signals, especially on hard problems; proposes CodeRM-8B. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Ling-Coder-DPO](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/ling-coder-dpo/): Code DPO pairs derived from CodeContests, choosing positive and negative samples by test pass rate, perplexity distribution and reward-model score. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 (HF card)]
- [Qwen3-Coder-Next OpenCode Preference](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/qwen3-coder-next-opencode-preference/): DPO pairs from rejection sampling: 8 samples per problem, chosen passes 100% of tests, rejected fails, with labeled rejection types. Companion to an SFT set of 49,374 examples. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0 (HF card)]
- [Vezora Code-Preference-Pairs](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/vezora-code-preference-pairs/): DPO-style pairs from the Open-Critic-GPT synthetic pipeline: code with inserted bugs as the rejected side. [dataset; license: other (HF card tag)]

### RL with verifiable rewards
- [AceReason-Nemotron](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-ace-reason/): Systematic RL ablations: math-only RL first then code-only RL; shows math RL also helps code. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [AceReason-Nemotron-14B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/acereason-nemotron-14b/): RL-only (math then code) from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B; card reports LiveCodeBench avg@8. [model; license: NVIDIA Open Model License]
- [Auditing Reward Hackability in Code RL Environments](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-reward-hack-audit/): Abstract reports 22.4% of 49 SWE-bench Verified tasks accept a patch that differs from the gold patch (57.8% with a stronger attacker). [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [CodeContests+](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/code-contests-plus/): CodeContests with LLM-generated, validated test generators and checkers to raise test quality, built using SandboxFusion; intended as better RL verifiers. [dataset; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [CodeContests-O](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codecontests-o/): Feedback-driven iterative test case generation for CodeContests problems: generators, checkers and corner cases. [dataset; license: not stated in card header (API license null); check card]
- [CodeRL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-coderl/): First widely cited framework using unit-test signals and an actor-critic to train code LMs with RL. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Coding or Cheating?](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-coding-or-cheating/): Frontier models try to recover answers from repo history and filesystems in hardened SWE environments. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [DAPO](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-dapo/): Open RL system with decoupled clip, dynamic sampling, token-level loss and overlong handling; 50 on AIME 2024 with Qwen2.5-32B base. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [DeepCoder RL recipe (GRPO+)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/recipe-deepcoder/): Open code-RL recipe: GRPO+ (DAPO ideas: clip-high, no KL loss), iterative context lengthening 16K to 32K, DAPO overlong filtering, and offline difficulty filtering of coding problems, on R1-Distill-Qwen-14B. [recipe; license: MIT (released model); blog]
- [DeepCoder-14B-Preview](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepcoder-14b-preview/): RL fine-tune of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B for code reasoning; card reports 60.6% Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v5 (8/1/24-2/1/25), versus 53.0 for the base distill. [model; license: MIT]
- [DeepCoder-Preview-Dataset](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepcoder-preview/): Verified-test competitive programming set used to train DeepCoder-14B: TACO verified, PrimeIntellect SYNTHETIC-1 code and LiveCodeBench problems with test lists. [dataset; license: MIT]
- [DeepSeek-R1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-deepseek-r1/): Shows reasoning can be incentivized with pure RL on verifiable rewards, including coding competitions. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [DeepSWE RL recipe (rLLM)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/recipe-deepswe/): Pure-RL SWE-agent recipe on Qwen3-32B with 4.5K R2E-Gym problems, repos overlapping SWE-bench Verified filtered out, built on rLLM. [recipe; license: MIT (model); blog]
- [DeepSWE-Preview](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepswe-preview/): RL-only coding agent trained on Qwen3-32B with 4.5K R2E-Gym problems (sympy-like repos shared with SWE-bench Verified filtered out); card reports SWE-bench Verified rising from 23% to 42% in 200 RL steps. [model; license: MIT]
- [Eurus-2-RL-Data](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/eurus-2-rl-data/): PRIME RL training set: outcome-verifiable math answers and coding test cases from APPS, CodeContests, TACO and Codeforces, deduplicated. [dataset; license: MIT]
- [EvilGenie: A Reward Hacking Benchmark](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-evilgenie/): Benchmark on LiveCodeBench problems where hacking is easy; LLM judges detect obvious hacks, held-out tests help only slightly. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-gspo/): Sequence-level importance ratios stabilize RL for MoE models. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Kimina-Prover-Promptset](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kimina-prover-promptset/): Lean 4 formal statements with natural-language versions used for Kimina-Prover RL. [dataset; license: none stated (API null)]
- [KodCode-Light-RL-10K](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/kodcode-light-rl-10k/): Filtered 10K subset of KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 for RL (GRPO/PPO); card reports GRPO runs on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. [dataset; license: CC-BY-NC-4.0]
- [Multi-SWE-RL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/multi-swe-rl/): ByteDance Seed community effort to collect multilingual SWE RL instances (unannotated new instances plus discarded Multi-SWE-bench instances). [environment; license: other (HF card says 'other'; see card)]
- [Nemotron-Cascade-14B-Thinking](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-cascade-14b/): Dec 2025 NVIDIA reasoning model trained with cascaded domain-wise RL (including SWE). [model; license: NVIDIA Open Model License]
- [Nemotron-RL-coding-competitive_coding](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemotron-rl-competitive-coding/): NeMo Gym RLVR set of Python competitive problems with unit tests from CodeContests and open-r1/codeforces. [dataset; license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 in card metadata, card text says CC-BY-4.0 (inconsistent)]
- [PPOCoder](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-ppocoder/): Combines pretrained code LMs with PPO using compiler/execution and structure-alignment feedback. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [ProRL: Prolonged RL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-prorl/): Long RL runs expand reasoning boundaries beyond the base model. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Reasoning Gym](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/reasoning-gym/): Library of procedurally generated reasoning tasks with programmatic verifiers, including code and algorithm tasks; infinite data. [environment; license: Apache-2.0]
- [RLTF: Reinforcement Learning from Unit Test Feedback](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-rltf/): Online RL with multi-granularity unit-test feedback (including error locations) to refine code LLMs. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [SkyRL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/skyrl/): Modular full-stack RL library for LLMs including agentic/SWE tasks. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Skywork Open Reasoner 1](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-skywork-or1/): Open RL implementation on R1-distill models; abstract reports average accuracy on AIME24, AIME25 and LiveCodeBench rising from 57.8% to 72.8% for 32B; includes ablations on core RL components. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Skywork-OR1-32B (and 7B)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/skywork-or1-32b/): RL on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B for math and code; paper reports LiveCodeBench-comparable to R1 and Qwen3-32B. [model; license: Apache-2.0 per GitHub repo (HF card license field not set)]
- [Skywork-OR1-RL-Data](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/skywork-or1-rl-data/): RL-ready math and code problems in verl format (prompt, reward_model.ground_truth) with per-model pass difficulty labels for 1.5B, 7B and 32B R1 distills. [dataset; license: Apache-2.0 on GitHub repo; HF card has no license field]
- [SWE-RL (Meta)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-swe-rl/): Scales RL for real-world software engineering with a lightweight rule-based reward (similarity to ground-truth patch) on open software evolution data. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training (Dr. GRPO)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-dr-grpo/): Finds GRPO length bias that inflates incorrect responses and proposes Dr. GRPO; also notes Qwen2.5 bases show strong reasoning without templates. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [verl](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/verl/): HybridFlow RL post-training framework used by DAPO and many code-RL recipes. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]

### Evaluation
- [Agentless](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-agentless/): A simple localize-repair-validate pipeline without autonomous agents that is competitive on SWE-bench. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [aider benchmark harness](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/aider-benchmark-harness/): Runs the polyglot benchmark in Docker against any model aider supports. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Aider Polyglot benchmark](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/aider-polyglot/): Hard Exercism exercises where the model must edit files in aider's format and pass tests, measuring instruction following plus multilingual editing. [benchmark; license: no license field in GitHub metadata (aider itself is Apache-2.0)]
- [Artificial Analysis (pointer)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/artificial-analysis/): Third-party site that aggregates model intelligence and coding indices; useful as a pointer to current coding scores. [tool; license: not applicable (third-party site)]
- [BigCodeBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/bigcodebench/): Python tasks requiring calls into many libraries with complex instructions,  [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [BigCodeBench-Hard](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/bigcodebench-hard/): Harder 148-task subset of BigCodeBench selected for lower solve rates, cheaper to run. [benchmark; license: license not stated in card metadata (parent is Apache-2.0)]
- [BIRD mini-dev and BIRD-Critic](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/bird-mini-dev/): Harder, more realistic text-to-SQL with execution-based evaluation; BIRD-Critic covers SQL debugging with test cases. [benchmark; license: CC-BY-SA-4.0]
- [CanItEdit](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/canitedit/): Hand-crafted instructional code editing problems with descriptive and lazy instruction variants, tested by execution. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [ClassEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/classeval/): Manually crafted class-level generation tasks (multiple interdependent methods), about 500 person-hours to build. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [CLEVER](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/clever/): Lean benchmark for end-to-end verified code generation: specification and implementation proven correct. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [CodeElo](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codeelo/): Competition-level benchmark that submits solutions to Codeforces to obtain human-comparable Elo ratings, avoiding the need for private tests. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [CodeScope](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/codescope/): Execution-based multilingual, multitask benchmark covering code understanding and generation across many languages. [benchmark; license: CC-BY-NC-4.0]
- [Commit0](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/commit0/): Agent must implement a library from its spec using interactive unit tests; measures long-form spec following. [benchmark; license: MIT (GitHub repo)]
- [CrossCodeEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/crosscodeeval/): Completion tasks that cannot be solved without cross-file context, in several languages, with static-analysis-based construction. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [CRUXEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/cruxeval/): Tests code reasoning and execution understanding: predict the output for a given input, or an input for a given output. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [CWEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/cweval/): Outcome-driven evaluation of both functionality and security of generated code using test oracles for CWE-linked tasks. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [CyberSecEval (Purple Llama)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/cyberseceval/): Meta's suite for insecure-code generation and cyber misuse, with later versions adding more tests; also in inspect_evals (cyberseceval_2 to 4). [benchmark; license: NOASSERTION in GitHub metadata (per-component licenses)]
- [DeepSeek-ProverBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deepseek-proverbench/): Held-out Lean 4 problems for DeepSeek-Prover-V2; related V1 training data deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Prover-V1 has license 'other'. [benchmark; license: not stated in API]
- [Defects4J](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/defects4j/): Classic real-fault Java repair and testing database with infrastructure; used by repair benchmarks such as RepairBench. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [DevEval (SDLC benchmark, arXiv 2403.08604)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deveval/): Evaluates LLMs across the software lifecycle: design, environment setup, implementation, acceptance and unit testing. Note the name clashes with other 'DevEval'/'DevBench' projects. [benchmark; license: not verified]
- [DS-1000](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/ds-1000/): StackOverflow-derived NumPy, Pandas, etc. problems with multi-criteria execution plus surface-form checks, with perturbed problems to reduce memorization. [benchmark; license: CC-BY-SA-4.0]
- [EvalPerf (Differential Performance Evaluation)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evalperf/): Efficiency-demanding tasks with expensive generated inputs and a compound metric that compares the speed of model solutions to reference solutions. [benchmark; license: not stated in HF metadata (EvalPlus repo is Apache-2.0)]
- [EvalPlus CLI](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evalplus-cli/): Evaluation framework behind HumanEval+, MBPP+ and EvalPerf with backends for HF, vLLM, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Bedrock. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [EvalScope](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evalscope/): Includes benchmarks for bigcodebench, ds1000, humaneval(plus), live_code_bench, mbpp(plus), swe_bench, swe_bench_pro and terminal_bench. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [FormalMATH](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/formalmath/): Large Lean 4 formal math benchmark spanning olympiad to undergraduate level. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [HumanEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/humaneval/): Function-from-docstring Python problems with unit tests, introduced with Codex. The original functional-correctness benchmark. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [HumanEval+ (EvalPlus)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evalplus-humanevalplus/): HumanEval with test suites expanded by LLM- and mutation-based input generation to catch plausible-but-wrong solutions. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [HumanEval-X](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/humaneval-x/): Multilingual extension of HumanEval with generation and translation tasks, released with CodeGeeX. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [HumanEvalPack (OctoPack)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/humanevalpack/): HumanEval extended to six languages and to fix, explain and synthesize tasks, used to evaluate instruction-tuned code models. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [Inspect AI / inspect_evals](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/inspect-evals/): Large eval collection including apps, bigcodebench, class_eval, ds1000, humaneval, mbpp, usaco, swe_bench, swe_lancer, livecodebench_pro, mle_bench, paperbench and cyberseceval_2 to 4. [tool; license: MIT]
- [lighteval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/lighteval/): Evaluation library with LiveCodeBench tasks (src/lighteval/tasks/tasks/lcb) among many others. [tool; license: MIT]
- [LiveCodeBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/livecodebench/): Contamination-aware benchmark from LeetCode, AtCoder and Codeforces with problem release dates; DeepCoder used the lcbv5 train problems for RL. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [LiveCodeBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-livecodebench/): Time-stamped contamination-free evaluation for code LLMs via continuously collected problems. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [LiveCodeBench Pro](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/livecodebench-pro/): Olympiad-medalist-annotated problems from Codeforces, ICPC and IOI, updated continually, with line-by-line analysis of failed model submissions. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0 (gated: auto-approve access)]
- [LiveOIBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/liveoibench/): Olympiad-level competitive programming benchmark using official test cases and offline judging, with human-contestant percentile comparison. [benchmark; license: not verified]
- [MBPP (Mostly Basic Python Problems)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/mbpp/): Crowd-written entry-level Python tasks with three asserts each. [benchmark; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [MBPP+ (EvalPlus)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/evalplus-mbppplus/): MBPP subset, cleaned of broken tasks and given 35x more tests, for stricter checking of basic Python generation. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [METR time-horizon task suite (HCAST, RE-Bench)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/metr-time-horizon/): Measures the 50% task-completion time horizon: the human task length models complete at 50% success. Reported to double about every seven months since 2019. [benchmark; license: public-tasks repo: NOASSERTION; archived]
- [miniF2F](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/minif2f/): Formal Olympiad-level problems (AIME, AMC, IMO, coursework) in Lean and other systems for theorem proving. [benchmark; license: MIT (facebookresearch updated version)]
- [MLE-bench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/mle-bench/): Agents train models, prepare data and run experiments on real Kaggle competitions, graded against human leaderboards. [benchmark; license: NOASSERTION in GitHub metadata (see repo)]
- [Multi-SWE-bench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/multi-swe-bench/): Multilingual issue-resolving benchmark annotated by 68 experts from 2,456 candidates. [benchmark; license: other (see dataset card)]
- [MultiPL-E](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/multipl-e/): A system that transpiles unit-test-based Python benchmarks to many programming languages, with prebuilt translated sets. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [OpenCompass](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/opencompass/): Includes configs for bigcodebench, cruxeval, ds1000, humaneval (plus, multi, x, pro), livecodebench, livecodebench_pro and mbpp (plus, pro). [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [PaperBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paperbench/): Agents replicate ML papers from scratch; rubric-graded by an LLM judge. Also ported to inspect_evals (paperbench). [benchmark; license: not verified]
- [ProjectEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/projecteval/): Project-level generation benchmark with three input levels, evaluated by simulated user interaction plus code similarity. [benchmark; license: not verified]
- [PutnamBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/putnambench/): Hard undergraduate competition math formalizations for neural theorem provers. [benchmark; license: no license field in GitHub metadata]
- [RepoBench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/repobench/): Repo-level code completion with retrieval (R), completion (C) and pipeline (P) tasks in Python and Java. [benchmark; license: CC (HF metadata 'cc'); GitHub repo CC-BY-4.0]
- [Rethinking Benchmark and Contamination (rephrased samples)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/paper-rephrased-contamination/): Shows rephrased benchmark samples evade n-gram decontamination and inflate scores. [paper; license: arXiv preprint (paper); check repo for code/data licenses]
- [SAFIM (Syntax-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/safim/): FIM benchmark focused on syntactic structures (blocks, conditionals, API calls), with problems sourced after April 2022 to reduce contamination. [benchmark; license: CC-BY-4.0]
- [SecCodePLT](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/seccodeplt/): Security benchmark built from validated seeds expanded by mutation, with dynamic tests for both code generation and cyberattack helpfulness. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [Spider 2.0](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/spider2/): Real enterprise workflows over BigQuery, Snowflake and local databases with 1,000+ columns, requiring metadata search, dialect docs and multi-step SQL. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [SWE-bench (full)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench/): Real GitHub issue plus repository; the agent must produce a patch that passes the repo's own tests (FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS). [benchmark; license: dataset card license not in HF metadata; harness repo is MIT]
- [SWE-bench (full, train/test splits)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-train/): The original 2,294-issue benchmark, now with eval_script, image and log_parser columns. A SWE-bench-Train subset (1,063 questions per the Nemotron-Cascade card) was used by Nemotron-Cascade. [benchmark; license: MIT (GitHub repo; HF card has no license field)]
- [SWE-bench evaluation harness](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-harness/): Official Docker harness that applies model patches and runs repo tests, used by Verified, Lite, Multilingual and Multimodal. [tool; license: MIT]
- [SWE-bench Lite](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-lite/): A cheaper filtered subset of SWE-bench for faster iteration. [benchmark; license: dataset card license not in HF metadata; harness repo MIT]
- [SWE-bench Multilingual](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-multilingual/): Issue-resolution tasks in C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Ruby and Rust, runnable in the SWE-bench harness with prebuilt images. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [SWE-bench Multimodal](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-multimodal/): JavaScript and front-end issue tasks where the problem statement includes images such as screenshots. [benchmark; license: license not in HF metadata]
- [SWE-Bench Pro](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-pro/): Long-horizon, enterprise-style tasks with a public set, a private held-out set, and a commercial set from proprietary startup repos, designed to resist contamination. [benchmark; license: license not in HF metadata (public set drawn from copyleft repos per paper)]
- [SWE-bench Verified](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-verified/): 500-task subset screened by human annotators for solvable, well-specified problems; long the headline agentic coding number. [benchmark; license: dataset card license not in HF metadata; harness repo MIT]
- [SWE-bench-Live](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-bench-live/): Continuously updated issue-resolution benchmark with docker_image, test_cmds and rebuild_cmds per task, intended to stay ahead of contamination. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [SWE-Lancer](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swe-lancer/): Independent engineering tasks graded by end-to-end tests plus managerial decisions, mapped to real payouts. [benchmark; license: repo openai/SWELancer-Benchmark: no license field; archived]
- [SWT-Bench](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/swt-bench/): Agents write reproduction tests for real GitHub issues; a good test fails before and passes after the golden patch. [benchmark; license: MIT]
- [Terminal-Bench 2.0](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/terminal-bench-2/): Hard terminal tasks in Harbor format (instruction, Docker environment, tests); official leaderboard at tbench.ai. Also terminal-bench 2.1, 3.0 and a science split on HF. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Terminal-Bench 3.0](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/terminal-bench-3/): Next Terminal-Bench generation, mirrored from the GitHub repo at tag v3.0.0 and runnable through Harbor. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]
- [TestGenEval](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/testgeneval/): Unit-test authoring and completion benchmark built from SWE-bench repositories, with a lite subset. [benchmark; license: license not in HF metadata]
- [USACO benchmark](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/usaco/): Olympiad programming problems with episodic inference methods (retrieval, self-reflection). [benchmark; license: no license field in GitHub metadata; HF mirror gated (manual)]
- [Verina](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/verina/): Verifiable code generation in Lean: each task has description, Lean code, signature, tests and rejected inputs; evaluates code, spec and proof generation. VerinaLite/Plus variants exist. [benchmark; license: Apache-2.0]

### Tools: data pipelines, sandboxes, trainers
- [Apptainer](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-apptainer/): HPC container runtime that runs without root; needed on clusters like Berzelius where Docker is unavailable. SWE images must be converted from Docker. [tool; license: NOASSERTION (BSD-style per project, verify)]
- [AReaL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-areal/): Async RL system for LLM agents (repo now under areal-project). Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [bigcode-dataset](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/bigcode-dataset/): The BigCode data repo: preprocessing filters, PII pipeline, near-deduplication and benchmark decontamination scripts for The Stack and StarCoder. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [bigcode-evaluation-harness](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-bigcode-eval/): Code LLM eval harness that executes untrusted generations; README provides Dockerfiles for evaluating in containers 'for security and reproducibility' and supports generating on GPUs then executing elsewhere. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [bubblewrap](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-bubblewrap/): Unprivileged namespace sandbox used by Flatpak; lightweight wrapper for running test commands. [tool; license: NOASSERTION (LGPL per upstream, verify)]
- [Data-Juicer](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/data-juicer/): One-stop data processing system with 100+ operators for text, code and multimodal data, including code filters and dedup. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [datasketch](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/datasketch/): Python library for MinHash, LSH, LSH Forest and HyperLogLog used for near-duplicate detection. [tool; license: MIT]
- [datatrove](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/datatrove/): Hugging Face's platform-agnostic data pipeline library: readers, filters, MinHash dedup, tokenization, and executors for local, Slurm and Ray. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [DCLM (DataComp-LM)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/dclm-baselines/): Framework and baselines for data curation experiments including fastText quality classifier filtering of web text. [tool; license: MIT]
- [decon (Ai2)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/decon/): Token-based decontamination tool that finds training documents containing eval instances and writes reports and cleaned datasets. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [deduplicate-text-datasets (suffix array)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/deduplicate-text-datasets/): Google's suffix-array exact substring dedup tool from the Lee et al. dedup paper. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Docker (Moby)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-docker/): Container runtime standard for SWE task images; shares the host kernel so isolation is weaker than microVMs. Default for SWE-bench, SWE-smith, R2E-Gym. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Dolma toolkit](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/dolma-toolkit/): Ai2 data toolkit: fast Rust tagger/mixer, Bloom filter dedup and mixing used for OLMo corpora. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [duplodocus](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/duplodocus/): Ai2 Rust CLI for exact and MinHash dedup over large JSONL datasets. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [E2B](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-e2b/): Open-source cloud sandboxes for agents (isolation technology not verified here). [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Firecracker](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-firecracker/): microVM monitor: strongest isolation for untrusted code at scale; underpins E2B-style sandboxes. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [GitHub Linguist](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/linguist/): The reference language-detection library and language list behind GitHub's language stats. [tool; license: MIT]
- [go-enry](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/go-enry/): Fast Go port of GitHub Linguist for programming language detection; used by The Stack v3 for language, vendor and generated-file flags. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [go-license-detector](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/go-license-detector/): Go library and CLI to detect open-source licenses in a repository's files, used in earlier The Stack pipelines. [tool; license: NOASSERTION in GitHub API (verify in repo)]
- [gVisor](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-gvisor/): User-space kernel for container isolation as an OCI runtime (runsc). [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Harbor](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/harbor/): Framework for running agents in containerized tasks: used for Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-bench adapters, and RL rollouts; supports Docker and cloud sandboxes. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Hugging Face tokenizers](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/hf-tokenizers/): Rust tokenizer library for training BPE, Unigram and WordPiece vocabularies. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [isolate](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-isolate/): IOI contest sandbox with cgroup limits; used by Judge0. [tool; license: NOASSERTION (GPL per upstream, verify)]
- [Judge0](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-judge0/): Online judge API with sandboxed execution for 60+ languages. [tool; license: GPL-3.0]
- [Kata Containers](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-kata/): Containers in lightweight VMs; Kubernetes friendly. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Licensee](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/licensee/): Ruby tool GitHub uses to detect a project's license from its LICENSE file. [tool; license: MIT]
- [lm-evaluation-harness (code tasks)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/lm-evaluation-harness/): The standard few-shot LLM harness; code coverage is basic. [tool; license: MIT]
- [Microsoft Presidio](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/presidio/): PII detection and anonymization SDK with recognizers and custom operators (repo moved from microsoft/presidio). [tool; license: MIT]
- [mini-swe-agent](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-mini-swe-agent/): Roughly 100-line bash-only agent; simple harness for RL rollouts. [tool; license: MIT]
- [Modal sandboxes (SDK)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-modal/): SDK for Modal, with Sandboxes for running untrusted code on demand; hosted service, SDK is open source. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [nanotron](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nanotron/): Minimalistic large-model pretraining library from Hugging Face, used with datatrove-tokenized data. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [NeMo Curator](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemo-curator/): GPU-accelerated data curation for LLMs: dedup (exact, fuzzy, semantic), quality classifiers, PII, decontamination, synthetic data. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [NeMo-RL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-nemo-rl/): NVIDIA scalable RL toolkit, pairs with NeMo Gym. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [nsjail](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-nsjail/): Namespace/seccomp/cgroup jail for process isolation. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [NVIDIA NeMo Gym](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/nemo-gym/): Framework and collection of RLVR environments and datasets (competitive coding, SWE) for NeMo-RL and other trainers. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Open-Instruct (AI2)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-open-instruct/): AI2 post-training codebase including RLVR (GRPO) training. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [OpenEnv](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/openenv/): Interface library for RL post-training with environments (Gym-style API served over containers). [tool; license: BSD-3-Clause]
- [OpenHands](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-openhands/): Agent platform and runtime with docker sandbox; used to generate SWE-Gym and Nemotron trajectories. [tool; license: MIT]
- [OpenRLHF](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-openrlhf/): Ray-based scalable RL framework with PPO/REINFORCE variants and agentic mode. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Piston](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-piston/): Multi-language code execution engine with API. [tool; license: MIT]
- [Podman](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-podman/): Daemonless, rootless Docker-compatible container engine; useful where a root daemon is not allowed. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [prime-rl](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-prime-rl/): Async agentic RL training at scale; integrates with verifiers environments. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Repo2RLEnv](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/repo2rlenv/): Hugging Face tool that turns any repository into verifiable RL environments for coding agents in Harbor task format (instruction, Dockerfile, tests, reward script). [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [rLLM](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-rllm/): Framework behind DeepCoder and SWE agent RL runs. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [ROLL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-roll/): Alibaba RL library with agentic pipelines. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SandboxFusion](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-sandboxfusion/): ByteDance code sandbox with many languages and datasets, built for RL code rewards; used to build CodeContests+. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [ScanCode Toolkit](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/scancode-toolkit/): License, copyright and package detection engine used by The Stack v2 and v3 for file-level license labels. [tool; license: NOASSERTION in GitHub API (mixed code and data licenses; verify in repo before redistribution)]
- [SentencePiece](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sentencepiece/): Unsupervised tokenizer for BPE/unigram; many code and multilingual models use it. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [SkyRL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-skyrl/): Modular full-stack RL library including SkyRL-gym environments and multi-turn SWE training. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [slime](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-slime/): SGLang-based RL scaling framework from Tsinghua/Z.ai. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [Software Heritage archive and graph](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/software-heritage-graph/): Universal archive of public source code; The Stack v2 sourced contents via SWH, and graph dataset/swh-graph tools allow bulk analysis. [tool; license: Archive content under original licenses; SWH terms of use apply (see legal page)]
- [SPDX license list data](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/spdx-license-list-data/): Canonical machine-readable list of SPDX license ids and texts. [tool; license: not shown by GitHub API; verify in repo (data is CC0 per SPDX docs, unverified here)]
- [Stack-Edu / Python-Edu classifiers](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/stack-edu-classifiers/): Educational-quality scorers for code (0-5 scale, LLM-annotated labels) used to build Stack-Edu and Python-Edu. [tool; license: not stated (HF license field unset); could not re-verify license]
- [StarPII (bigcode)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/starpii/): BigCode's NER model for detecting names, emails, keys, passwords and IPs in code, used for The Stack v2/v3 PII redaction. [tool; license: gated (auto) BigCode terms; license field unset in API]
- [SWE-agent](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/sb-swe-agent/): Princeton agent harness for GitHub issue tasks. [tool; license: MIT]
- [text-dedup](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/text-dedup/): Collection of deduplication methods for text: MinHash, SimHash, suffix array, Bloom filter, exact hash. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [tiktoken](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/tiktoken/): Fast BPE tokenizer library; reference for counting tokens in mixes. [tool; license: MIT]
- [tree-sitter](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/tree-sitter/): Incremental parser with grammars for many languages; used to parse code for syntax filtering, AST-based chunking and function extraction. [tool; license: MIT]
- [TRL](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-trl/): Hugging Face RL library with GRPO trainer and custom reward functions. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
- [verifiers (Prime Intellect)](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/prime-verifiers/): Library for RL environments and evals; environments are installable packages and can be published to the Prime Intellect Environments Hub. [tool; license: MIT]
- [verl](https://code.renaissancelabs.eu/r/fw-verl/): HybridFlow RL post-training framework; supports GRPO/PPO with rule-based and sandbox code rewards. Verified active on GitHub API. [tool; license: Apache-2.0]
